## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals: Real Estate, Utilities and Materials are strong while Technology and Financials lag; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate) — two confirmations for CAUTION: sector divergence (cyclicals/REITs strong vs Tech/Fin weak) and concentrated leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%). Utilities strong: EXC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%), AEP ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%). Materials showing strength: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: C BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%), BAC CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%). Technology weak: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%). Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%), TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -4.95%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%), TMUS ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate) — concentrated REIT strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -14.61%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%), C BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%), CSCO CORRECTION (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +3.28%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%), TMUS ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%). Note major divergence set (ORCL, MSFT, UNH, TSLA) — tactical, not decisive for core positioning.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak, selective bounces amid broader sluggishness: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%). Sector breadth: ~6/19 positive — rotation away from large-cap Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Under pressure and internally bifurcated: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%), BAC CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%). Sector breadth: ~4/20 positive — Financials showing weakness, risk to cyclical exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed signals with idiosyncratic headlines: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%). Sector breadth: ~7/15 positive — watch headline-driven dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to strong REITs and selected cyclicals showing confirmed 1W+1M strength (EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%)). Reduce exposure to pressured large-cap Tech and Financial names showing BELOW TREND behavior (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), C BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%)). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given concentrated gains.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), EXC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), C BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (Real Estate breadth: 5/6 positive), Utilities (Utilities breadth: 5/6 positive), Materials (Materials breadth: 5/7 positive). BEARISH: Financials (Financials breadth: ~4/20 positive), Technology (Technology breadth: ~6/19 positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) — watch for follow-through above recent breakout levels. ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) — failure to hold this week’s gains would invalidate the short-term reversal. AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) — sustained weakness below recent support would extend Tech underperformance.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TMUS (+80): TMUS ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) — strong results and capital return plan; price confirms sentiment. EQIX (+55): EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) — AI-driven outlook and dividend lift; price confirms accumulation. AMT (+55): AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) — positive analyst takes but juxtaposed with tenant-risk headlines (see bearish) — price up, sentiment mixed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-50): UNH RECOVERY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) — Medicare Advantage headwinds headline but 1W bounce shows short-term divergence. AAPL (-45): AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) — negative headlines align with price decline (confirmation). AMT (-45): AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) — negative tenant-risk story diverges from strong price action; watch for distribution. CCI (-45): CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) — negative guidance talk vs price strength signals potential volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) and EXC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) are showing strength. Major divergences (ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%), UNH RECOVERY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%)) and headline-driven splits on AMT/CCI are the key risks to monitor.
